entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. It's not what I wanted and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
I don't have to give you a reason! It's buyer's remorse, fine. Your website says 90 days. I'm within my 90 days, so process the refund. It's that simple.
I understand. I'm just pulling up your order details now. Can you confirm the order number or the email address used for the purchase?
It's angrycustomer@email.com. Just get it done, I don't have all day.

Thank you. Okay, I see the order. It was delivered on December 15th, which was 21 days ago. For many of our wearable devices, that is unfortunately **too late** to start a return. The **policy** for items worn on the body is much stricter now due to **hygiene** and **sanitation** protocols.

WHAT?! Are you kidding me? Too late?! Your website says 90 days! This is a bait and switch! I want to speak to your manager right now! This is completely unacceptable and I will be posting about this on every review site I can find!

I understand your frustration, sir, and I sincerely apologize for the confusion. Please allow me to double-check something. One moment... Okay, I see what happened. You are absolutely correct. The stricter hygiene policy I mentioned applies to our new Pulse heart rate monitors. Your item, the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, is a standard item and falls under our 90-day return policy. My mistake entirely.
So you're telling me I can return it? After all that?

Yes, absolutely. You are well within the 90-day window. I can process this return for you immediately. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email. As soon as we receive the item, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method. Again, I am very sorry for the mix-up.
Fine. Just make sure it goes through this time. I'll be watching my account.
I will personally ensure it does. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
